Synthetic First Alert interval digests with the layout of the owner's Gmail-connector files
(ADR 0012). Every alert, account key, URL and post here is invented; no Dataminr content is
committed. Variants covered: priority badges and "Update" alerts, the AI-summary icon line,
place on the pin line or on its own line, "Original Public Post" / "Translated From",
a Telegram excerpt with an image and no original link, a one-line "Interval Digest" header,
an X protest alert (dropped), and an alert re-delivered in a later digest.
